name: Epidiolex
effects: FDA-approved for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome, Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, and TSC
Non-intoxicating pure CBD formulation (100 mg/mL oral solution)
Therapeutic dose: 2.5 mg/kg/day, titrated to 5–10 mg/kg/day maintenance
Important drug-drug interactions: CYP2C19 inhibitor — raises levels of clobazam/norclobazam
Hepatotoxicity risk at high doses — LFT monitoring required

halfLifeEvidence.quote: The half-life of cannabidiol in plasma was 56 to 61 hours after twice-daily dosing for 7 days in healthy subjects.
halfLifeEvidence.identity: the source is about this substance
halfLifeEvidence.note: The product's own label, on its own twice-daily schedule. The 18-32 hour figure on the cannabidiol article is for cannabidiol generally, not for this product.
